INTENTGRAPH2-ATTACK_DAMAGE_FORMAT.title: Attack Damage Format
Customize how to display damage value of attacks. Takes effect in combat only.
{base} - the base damage.
{modified} - the damage modified by buffs and relics.
{base:total} - multiply base damage and count.
{modified:total} - multiply modified damage and count.
